# MyDoctorBook - Official Healthcare Platform

> MyDoctorBook is India's leading digital health platform for booking doctor consultations, OPD ticket tokens, diagnostic lab tests, and emergency blood & organ donor network matching.

## Core Platform Services & Pages

- [Doctor Appointment Booking](https://mydoctorbook.in/doctors)
- [Diagnostic Lab Test Marketplace](https://mydoctorbook.in/labs)
- [Online Pharmacy Medicine Delivery](https://mydoctorbook.in/pharmacy)
- [Doctor Comparison & Specialization Battle](https://mydoctorbook.in/compare)
- [Digital ABHA Health ID & Health Capsule Vault](https://mydoctorbook.in/health-capsule)
- [Official Website Homepage](https://mydoctorbook.in/)
